reason: A DSH web UI panel for browsing, searching, tagging, viewing, downloading, and restoring archived sessions, with an embedded agent assistant and host shutdown control.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中浏览、搜索、标记、查看、下载和恢复归档会话的管理面板，并提供嵌入式 AI 助手与关闭主机功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web UI panel for browsing, searching, tagging, viewing, downloading, and restoring archived sessions, with an embedded AI assistant and host shutdown control.

capabilities: Reads archived session metadata and conversation logs
Adds and removes persistent session tags through a local HTTP API
Restores archived sessions to their original workspace groups
Downloads session logs as ZIP files
Invokes a DSH agent to search and organize sessions
Creates and deletes helper sessions used by the AI assistant
Requests graceful shutdown of the DSH host
